subject: Can a shiny web application be made WCAG 2.0 compliant?

messages.author: 709a0abc29660654
messages.subject: Can a shiny web application be made WCAG 2.0 compliant?
parts:
Hello,

I am considering to use Shiny to disclose an R-package to the web. One of the requirements is WCAG 2.0 compliancy.

Does anybody have experience with this? Can it be done?

The user interface will consist of a sequence of 5 pages in which the user supplies data and parameters, by uploading a data file, selecting options form radio groups and drop down lists, etc. The output will be tables of numbers and/or graphs.

Any help will be appreciated.
